hard_stops: The sculpted neck gable became a sticker scroll gable below a separate peaked brick cap, changing the defining silhouette.
The long side and rear are almost entirely blank despite side windows and roof openings in the exact oblique reference.
The roof is a generic uninterrupted gable and the entrance remains essentially planar.
strongest_faithful_traits: Convincing dark Dutch brick, sash-window texture and narrow vertical proportion on the front plane.
Twin ground-floor doors and scroll ornament retain some archetype identity.
Front sticker window rows are internally aligned without obvious horizontal registration jumps.
buildings.biggest_archetype_gap: A decorated facade is attached to a blank generic shed rather than a complete canal-corner merchant house.
buildings.next_correction: Replace the upper/front junction with one source-traced neck-gable silhouette joined to the steep tiled roof, carry the side-window and dormer grid onto the long elevation, and remove the separate triangular cap.

hard_stops: The zinc mansard and courtyard roof with repeated dormers became a square hipped roof without a mansard break, dormer rhythm or courtyard logic.
The corner dome is an oversized bulb on a blank cylindrical band rather than an integrated pavilion, ribbed zinc dome, glazed cupola and finial.
An untextured strip at the chamfer and blank rear walls expose sticker seams and break facade continuity.
Oversized physical rails duplicate photographed balconies, while the cafe canopy is absent and the shop entrance remains flat.
strongest_faithful_traits: The limestone/red-brick palette, French-window cadence and decorative spandrel texture are strong on the sticker planes.
The corner-building concept and ribbed dome gesture make the type recognisable.
The timber shopfront texture has useful warmth and scale.
buildings.biggest_archetype_gap: The roof and corner pavilion are architecturally different from the archetype, and added geometry fights the sticker.
buildings.next_correction: Rebuild the corner and roof as one source-derived chamfered pavilion with a zinc mansard break, aligned dormers, and a proportioned ribbed dome on a fenestrated cupola; remove the blank cylinder and duplicate balcony geometry.

hard_stops: The ornate sticker gable sits below a separate physical brick triangle, doubling the source's integrated cross-gable.
The compound cross-gabled roof and projecting bay roof are reduced to a simple rectangular two-slope roof.
Side and rear elevations are blank despite visible domestic fenestration and articulation in the references.
The oversized porch crosses the bay and doorway instead of aligning with the right-hand entrance, which lacks a recessed threshold.
The street reference is predominantly red brick while the generated front is yellow, making reference and sticker selection inconsistent.
strongest_faithful_traits: The projecting bay, stained-glass panels and Victorian bargeboard imagery convey the decorative family.
Narrow detached-house proportions and asymmetrical bay/entrance composition are recognisable.
Brick and window textures are detailed and vertically coherent within the front sticker.
buildings.biggest_archetype_gap: Strong front imagery is mounted onto an incorrect roof box with a doubled gable and misregistered porch.
buildings.next_correction: Derive the complete roof and bay silhouette from the aerial reference, make the ornate front gable the actual cross-gable volume, delete the extra triangle, and anchor a scaled porch solely around the right entrance.

shared_hard_stops: Accurate front stickers terminate at generic or blank side/rear masses.
Roof geometry is not derived tightly enough from aerial references.
Physical overlays duplicate photographed detail instead of adding only depth-bearing construction.
Entrances remain planar images rather than recessed thresholds and interiors.
Comparison renders are not camera-matched to exact sources, so export parity does not validate architectural likeness.
batch.methodology_priority: Require a source-matched silhouette/roof proxy and all-elevation occupancy map to pass before sticker generation. Treat blank visible side/rear walls, duplicated gables or rails, and unmatched reference cameras as automatic QA failures.
